indicators.name: US Home Price YoY Growth (S&P/Case-Shiller via FRED: CSUSHPISA)
indicators.note: Value is year-over-year home-price appreciation; change is the month-over-month shift in that YoY rate (i.e. whether asset-wealth gains are accelerating or decelerating), not a simple index-point diff.

indicators.name: Strategic Petroleum Reserve — Crude Oil Stocks (EIA, weekly)
Energy Price Volatility — WTI 20-Day Realized Vol (FRED: DCOILWTICO)
indicators.note: Annualized realized volatility of WTI crude over the trailing 20 trading days — the swing, not the price level, is the Pillar 4 signal (supply-shock/geopolitical exposure).

indicators.name: Forcibly Displaced Persons — Global Total (UNHCR)
indicators.note: Refugees + asylum-seekers + IDPs + other people in need of international protection, per UNHCR's own ‘forcibly displaced’ definition. Annual release — value is static between updates.
